name: VoxShield
description: The release of public 3D medical image segmentation (MIS) datasets accelerates clinical research but simultaneously heightens risks of unauthorized AI model training. While Unlearnable Examples (UE) offer protection by injecting imperceptible perturbations to prevent effective model learning, existing methods primarily target 2D scenarios. They neglect the volumetric spatial correlations and inter-slice anatomical consistency inherent in 3D medical volumes, which serve as critical learning priors for 3D segmentation networks.
